messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] KV cache continuous-batching growth detected — service latency P95 > 2s, error-rate increased 4x. Pager: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8721 · retry_count spike on runtime edges.

incident-bot: Metrics snapshot: prefix_cardinality=1.2M, kv_entries=18M (+300% in 10m), cont_batch_inflight=4800, avg_batch_size=56, token_throughput down 32%.

Ash (oncall): on it. Paging Priya and Marco. Any customer-facing impact seen?

Priya (eng-sre): seeing large KV eviction churn + OOMs on some shards. Throttle signals from qps‑controller kicking in, but requests still piling in. Noticing this only on model variants using MQA path (mistral-mqa and qwen-mqa). Llama endpoints less affected but tail latency creeping.

Marco (runtime): confirmed. Root cause looks like combination of aggressive continuous-batching config + prefetch warmups for high-cardinality prefixes. Prefetch window exploded for certain prompt prefix sets (autosuggest use-case).

Lena (ml-runtime): added: model-specific observation — MQA decoder caches keep growing because KV key shapes differ when speculative sampling path is enabled. GQA traffic for the same routes is okay.

Jen (cust-success): we have an open conversation with Sami from BigRetail — they reported timeouts in prod around 10:03. Sami, can you confirm if the spikes correspond?

Sami (customer): yes, customers saw a few 502s and slow autocomplete. We routed around them but some checkout flows timed out for ~3m.

Ash (oncall): severity = Sev2 for now — partial customer impact and degraded latency. Adding oncall runbook steps. @Priya please run the quick mitigations in order.

Priya (eng-sre): Running mitigation checklist: 1) reduce cont_batch.max_size 2) disable aggressive prefetch 3) enable kv prefix eviction policy (soft). Doing step 1 now:
```yaml
# hotfix: reduce batch size
cont_batch:
  max_size: 24  # from 128 -> 24
  backoff_ms: 10
```
Applying to canary shard group-7.

Marco (runtime): canary applied. Observing avg_batch_size drop from 56 -> 22 on canary. KV growth rate on canary flattened.

Priya (eng-sre): step 2 rolling: turning off prefetch for routes matching /autocomplete/*:
```bash
redwoodctl route update --match '/autocomplete/*' --prefetch disabled --dry-run=false
```
Rolling 25% -> 50% -> 100% in 3m.

Lena (ml-runtime): note: for mistral-mqa we also flipped speculative_sampling=false on canary to avoid creating new kv shapes. Doing that on canary as well.

Marco (runtime): canary stable for 10m. P95 latency down 40% on canary, error-rate back to baseline. Rolling hotfix to remaining shards in 2 waves.

incident-bot: Deploy job #deploy/kv-hotfix-289112 triggered by @Priya · CI: green · ETA full roll 7m.

Ash (oncall): after roll complete, run a controlled increase on qps to validate no regressions. Priya, coordinate. Marco, watch memory/eviction metrics.

Priya (eng-sre): roll finished. Global avg_batch_size down to 25, kv_entries growth stabilized. We still see a small tail for qwen-mqa  — investigating slow drains.

Lena (ml-runtime): qwen-mqa is hitting a corner where prefix expansion combined with byte-level tokenization creates many distinct keys. Proposed longer-term: dedupe prefix normalization + limit speculative branches for MQA. Filing RFC.

Jen (cust-success): notified Sami and BigRetail CS — we sent an interim note: "We mitigated an inference perf regression impacting autocomplete and some timeouts. We rolled a hotfix reducing batching/prefetch; traffic normalized. Engineers continuing root-cause analysis." Sami acknowledged and appreciates the quick response.

Sami (customer): thanks, the traffic looks stable now. We saw a 70% improvement after the hotfix. Will follow up if anything else pops.

Priya (eng-sre): quick customer impact summary: 10:02–10:06 UTC, elevated latencies and ~120 5xxs for BigRetail, affecting search/autocomplete. No data loss. Root cause: runaway KV growth from high-cardinality prefix + MQA speculative sampling expanding key shapes + aggressive cont-batching config.

Ash (oncall): Next steps (short): 1) keep prefetch off for all autocomplete routes 24h, 2) schedule controlled canary for speculative_sampling=false on all MQA routes, 3) add metric alert for kv_entries growth > 25%/10m. Long: RFC on prefix normalization + batching policy per-model.

Marco (runtime): I pushed a patch to runtime to cap speculative kv branches per-request (opt-in flag). Will run perf test tomorrow.

Lena (ml-runtime): I'll own the RFC and propose model heuristics (MQA vs GQA) + tokenizer-aware prefix hashing to reduce cardinality.

Jen (cust-success): drafting customer postmortem blurb for BigRetail; will share after root cause details locked.

incident-bot: @oncall escalate to next shift in 45m.

Ash (oncall): Handoff summary for next oncall: 1) incident ID PD-8721, impact window 10:02–10:06 UTC, hotfix applied (cont_batch.max_size -> 24, prefetch disabled), current state: stable. 2) watch kv_entries and prefix_cardinality; thresholds set to alert at +25%/10m. 3) pending tasks: RFC for normalization, runtime cap patch rollout, disable speculative_sampling global canary.

Priya (eng-sre): taking notes — will update the incident doc and tag this thread. Attaching a short timeline in incident doc after this thread.

Ash (oncall): thanks all — handing off to @Priya for the next 3h. If anything flares, page PD immediately. :thumbsup:
